description: The bar chart, titled “Accuracy by different attributes on multi-retrieval task (n=2),” illustrates the performance of four language models—Qwen2.5-7b-1M, Internlm3-8b, ProLong-8b, and Qwen2.5-7b—across five distinct attributes: hobby, university, major, and birthdate, with a gray bar labeled “hobby” in the legend but no corresponding gray bar visible in the chart (likely an error or placeholder). The horizontal axis lists the models, while the vertical axis represents accuracy as a percentage, ranging from 0 to 100 with tick marks at intervals of 20. For each model, four colored bars indicate accuracy on each attribute: teal for “hobby,” orange for “university,” blue for “major,” and green for “birthdate.” Qwen2.5-7b-1M shows high accuracy across all attributes, with values approximately 90% for hobby, 88% for university, 85% for major, and 88% for birthdate. Internlm3-8b performs moderately, with accuracy around 70% for hobby, 75% for university, 65% for major, and 88% for birthdate. ProLong-8b has accuracy values near 68% for hobby, 78% for university, 60% for major, and 83% for birthdate. Qwen2.5-7b, the smallest model, performs poorly, with accuracy below 10% for all attributes except birthdate, which reaches about 15%. The chart visually emphasizes the superior performance of Qwen2.5-7b-1M and the relative weakness of Qwen2.5-7b, particularly on non-birthdate attributes.
